presets.name: Stage 73 - Early '70s
presets.description: Rounded attack, restrained bell, passive-style bass control. Editable approximation, not an exact replica.

presets.name: Suitcase 73 - Mid '70s
presets.description: Warm voicing, gentle EQ and slow stereo movement. Editable approximation, not an exact replica.

presets.name: Stage 73 - Late '70s
presets.description: Firmer attack and open upper partials. Editable approximation, not an exact replica.

presets.name: Suitcase 73 - Late '70s
presets.description: Clearer attack and lively stereo movement. Editable approximation, not an exact replica.

presets.name: Stage 73 - '80s
presets.description: Articulate attack and restrained decay. Editable approximation, not an exact replica.

presets.name: Original
presets.description: The 0.1.2 engine: production pickup at 1.5 / 0.5 mm, original losses. No limiter.

presets.name: Close Original
presets.description: Production pickup at 0.5 / 0.25 mm; level compensated. Original losses.

presets.name: Close Aperture
presets.description: Finite-aperture pickup at 0.5 / 0.5 mm with a 2 mm pole; original losses.

presets.name: Calibrated
presets.description: Aperture pickup at 0.5 / 0.5 mm, recording-derived sustain, soft second partial.

presets.name: Calibrated Register
presets.description: Calibrated with the validated upper-register pickup geometry; normal MIDI dynamics.
